exposure: density of day cares in each neighborhood
outcome: reported incident cases of confirmed and probable pertussis
cohort: Children aged birth through six years in Philadelphia between 2001 and 2013, including cases with probable pertussis diagnoses and controls from the city's immunization information system.
finding: Pertussis clustering was observed at the neighborhood level in Philadelphia, but the density of day cares in each neighborhood was unrelated to the distribution of pertussis cases.
